t: What Environmental Toxicity Database Is All About
title: What Environmental Toxicity Database Is All About
description: Toxicity is dose, pathway, and species: Paracelsus (1538) — 'the dose makes the poison.' LD50 (lethal dose for half the test animals) ranks acute toxicity; endocrine disruptors break the dose rule with low-dose effects. DDT thinned eagle eggshells (Silent Spring, 1962); lead's neurotoxicity lowered a generation's IQ before phase-outs. Pathways — ingestion, inhalation, dermal — decide the real exposure. This database is the complete toxicity record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Environmental Toxicity Database: a complete reference database of full toxicity record records.
key_points: What this database holds: full toxicity record records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.
